text: The Board confirms that these nominees are qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. Thank you for your consideration of this matter. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Community Centre 55 Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 30, 2030 and until successors are appointed: - Pauline Grant - Patrick Sweeney
